title: The Latency Gambit
logline: When an orbital combat drone arena rigs wagers with artificial transmission delay, a destitute former operator hires a pilot to expose the broadcast jammer.

roles.description: Controls the drone arena betting slate; smooth, calculating, and alters cockpit comms latency to manipulate dogfight outcomes.
A bankrupt remote drone pilot who lost their ship and reputation when an engineered latency spike crashed their champion chassis.
A modified electronic-warfare cutter disguised as an ordinary orbital broadcast relay dish.
A cavernous depressurized dome where remote-piloted kinetic drones battle for paying crowds.
The raucous trading mezzanine where syndicates trade leveraged wagers on drone structural integrity.
The mutual union of freelance drone pilots whose livelihoods depend on fair telemetry latency.

public_situation: Crowds pack the viewing galleries of {system}'s combat drone arena as syndicate bookmakers offer lopsided odds on the evening dogfights.
private_truth: The arena bookmaker operates a covert transmitter that injects hundred-millisecond latency spikes into underdog cockpits to guarantee favored wins.

beats.public_change: The arena announces record betting pools for the upcoming heavyweight drone elimination bracket.

missions.reason: The operator asks the pilot to purchase shielded fiber-optic telemetry couplers from an outer depot to bypass arena comms repeaters.
missions.private_fact: The operator pawned their cybernetic neural jack to buy the replacement couplers.

beats.public_change: The bookmaker issues a security decree banning third-party diagnostic scanners inside the arena dome.

missions.reason: The operator needs the pilot to scan the arena's broadcast gantry to isolate the directional jamming frequency.
missions.private_fact: The telemetry recorder shows thirty prior matches where losing drones suffered identical sub-space lag spikes right before impact.

beats.public_change: A broadcast relay cutter takes up position along the arena perimeter to flood the band with static.

missions.reason: The operator begs the pilot to cripple the cutter before it burns out the diagnostic recorder with an electromagnetic pulse.
missions.private_fact: The cutter captain hails mid-fight, offering a lucrative percentage of the evening's betting spread to drop the pursuit.

beats.public_change: The championship bout begins as thousands of spectators roar from the gallery stands.

missions.reason: The operator asks the pilot to deliver the extracted jamming telemetry straight to the exchange board before bets settle.
missions.private_fact: The operator's own former co-pilot is flying the favored drone and is unaware the match has been pre-rigged.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot stands at the betting exchange with proof of the bookmaker's latency rigging. The bookmaker offers a massive bribe to bury the drive.

options.label: Broadcast the jamming logs to void all rigged bets and ruin the bookmaker
Force the bookmaker to fund a restitution chest compensating ruined drone operators
Sell the drive to the bookmaker and let the rigged finals proceed

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the latency logs to the betting exchange.
resolutions.summary: {role:operators_guild} riots and seizes the arena floor; {role:arena_bookmaker} is ruined while {role:ruined_operator} regains operator accreditation.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved the combat drone arena was lagging pilots' controls to fix dogfights.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the bookmaker to fund operator restitution.
resolutions.summary: {role:arena_bookmaker} pays massive restitution to {role:operators_guild}, keeping the arena open under strict latency monitoring.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the bribe or sells the diagnostic drive.
resolutions.summary: The rigged dogfight concludes as planned; {role:arena_bookmaker} reaps a fortune while {role:ruined_operator} is barred from the arena.

resolutions.reached_by: The deliveries fail or the pilot drops the contract.
resolutions.summary: The bookmaker's jammer wipes the diagnostic drive; {role:ruined_operator} defaults on debts while {role:arena_bookmaker} tightens arena security.

loose_threads.detail: Telemetry recordings show directional microwave pulses synchronized precisely with bookmaker betting shifts.
The bookmaker's betting escrow is underwritten by high-interest debt instruments held by an offshore banking cartel.

radio_hooks: Combat drone arena in {system} posts record betting handle for championship elimination.
Drone operators' guild demands external audit following spate of erratic telemetry crashes.
Arena bookmakers dismiss interference claims, citing localized ion storm interference.

voice_direction.arena_bookmaker: Smooth, calculating, speaking with easy theatrical charm while masking total indifference to pilot safety.
voice_direction.ruined_operator: Edgy, twitchy, speaking in rapid staccato bursts filled with technical avionics jargon and bitter resentment.
